# api-patterns: what it prints

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_demos.py from real runs; do not edit by
     hand. CI fails when this file no longer matches the code. -->

Real output of [api-patterns](../../plugins/api-patterns) on the fixtures its own
tests use. Skills and subagents are not shown: what they say depends on the
model, and they are measured by the eval cases in the plugin's `evals/`.

## check_api_calls.py on prompt caching that never hits

A timestamp in the cached prefix, one breakpoint too many and a prefix too short to be stored: none of them raises an error at runtime.

```console
$ python3 plugins/api-patterns/scripts/check_api_calls.py plugins/api-patterns/tests/fixtures/bad_caching.py
ERROR  bad_caching.py:12  [volatile-prefix]
        cached system contains 'datetime.now', which changes between calls
        → A cached prefix must be byte identical every time. One varying value means the cache is written and never read — you pay the write premium on every request and get nothing.
ERROR  bad_caching.py:26  [too-many-breakpoints]
        5 cache_control breakpoints; the maximum is 4
        → The request is rejected. Cache the longest stable prefixes, not every block.
warn   bad_caching.py:42  [short-prefix]
        cached system prompt is only about 49 characters
        → A prefix under the model's minimum is not stored at all, and no error says so — the breakpoint is simply inert. Most models sit at 1024 tokens; the range across models runs from 512 to 4,096, so check the one you call. Then check `cache_creation_input_tokens`.
note   bad_caching.py  [unverified-caching]
        cache_control is used but usage is never read
        → `cache_read_input_tokens` is the only proof a cache hit happened. Log it once — a silently missing cache looks exactly like a working one.

3 API call(s): 2 error(s), 2 to look at
[exit 1]
```

## fuse.py merges two retrievers with reciprocal rank fusion

Documents found by both rankings rise to the top.

```console
$ python3 plugins/api-patterns/scripts/fuse.py plugins/api-patterns/tests/fixtures/rankings.json
id  score     ranks
s2  0.032522  bm25#2, semantic#1
s7  0.032266  bm25#1, semantic#3
s6  0.016129  semantic#2
s9  0.015873  bm25#3
s1  0.015625  semantic#4

Found by more than one retriever: s2, s7 — agreement is what RRF rewards.
[exit 0]
```
